messages:
maria: heads up — we just started getting a bunch of MissingAuditLog events for private endpoints in eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
raj: saw that too. any config churn? last ACL change was 10:04 UTC per iam-audit.
kevin: gpu fleet in eu-west-1 noticed degraded throughput about the same time. some pods retrying on model shards :frowning:
anna: are logs totally gone or delayed? which endpoint?
maria: looks like the KMS encrypt/decrypt traffic for the privatelink endpoint (vpce-0a12b3c4) stopped being allowed by the endpoint policy. Not sure who pushed it.
raj: that explains audit logs — privatelink had a policy limiting kms:Decrypt to our prod role but the condition was tightened. suspect a service-account -> role binding change.
maria: timeline: 10:03 UTC deploy job `infra/privatelink-policy` applied; 10:05 alerts spike. Reverting now if we need.
kevin: ops note: when KMS requests fail for the NVMe-backed shards we see repeated key fetch retries and transient CPU on the GPU hosts increases, which looks like our token refresh loop. GPUs show higher tail latency.
maria: trying a quick read-only diff: `aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --vpc-endpoint-ids vpce-0a12b3c4 --query PolicyDocument`
raj: if revert, prefer a scoped rollback to previous policy instead of full delete. we should avoid opening to everyone.
anna: can someone post the runbook link? I'll start collecting logs and a timeline for compliance.
maria: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privatelink-kms-audit. I'm attaching the `aws iam get-role-policy` snippet I ran:
```
aws iam get-role-policy --role-name infra-runner --policy-name privatelink-admin
```
output showed an unexpected `StringEquals` on `aws:SourceVpc`
kevin: I'm going to temporarily pin affected workloads to other regions (us-west-2) and move some batch jobs off eu-west-1 until this is resolved.
deploy-bot: automated revert suggestion queued by infra-ci for `infra/privatelink-policy` (change-id: ch-2026-0426-78) — approve with `/deploy approve ch-2026-0426-78`
maria: don't approve until we confirm exact condition — need least-privilege fix.
oncall-bot: paging oncall@redwood — incident created: INC-2026-0426-privatelink (severity: high).
raj: action items: 1) block revert until policy diff review (maria+raj) 2) collect KMS error logs + host metrics (anna+kevin) 3) escalate to security if policy change wasn't approved (maria)
anna: collecting `cloudtrail` and `vpcflow` now — will drop artifacts in /tmp/privatelink-20260426.tgz and link to the incident.
kevin: I've started region failover plan for non-prod shards. core production clusters will wait for policy fix.
maria: pinging infra-terraform owner @raj for quick review. if we can patch the policy to allow kms:Decrypt from the service principal and keep SourceVpc condition, that should be minimal risk.
raj: on it, will iterate in a branch and post a diff in ~15m.
anna: noted for compliance — we lost audit continuity for ~2m before alerts triggered. capturing window and annotating.
maria: thanks team. keep updates here and in INC-2026-0426. :thumbsup:
